summary: Tested P2 per-site analytics and P3 custom domain features end-to-end (backend pytest + frontend Playwright). All 11 backend tests passed (1 skipped: only 1 published template available so 409 duplicate test skipped). All frontend flows verified: views badge on cards, views chip in header, views-total + 14-bar sparkline in share dialog, view count increments after hitting /api/p/{slug} in a new tab (5 -> 6), custom domain connect (example.com) shows pending badge + DNS instructions, verify with example.com stays pending, verify with app-host flips to Verified badge, remove clears back to input. Cleanup: custom domain successfully removed so app host is not hijacked. Regression: ZIP download and slug rename still work.
critical_code_review_comments: templates.py is ~400 lines and now covers generation+publish+analytics+domains+SEO+ZIP. Consider splitting analytics & custom-domain routes into their own modules for maintainability.
verify_domain uses socket.getaddrinfo on request-thread offloaded to threadpool — good; DNS caching could be added to reduce latency.

Duplicate-domain check uses find_one but there is no unique index on custom_domain — race condition possible between two concurrent PUT /domain calls. Add a partial unique index {custom_domain: 1} (unique, sparse) to prevent duplicates at DB level.
